integrity: The strict sign conclusion follows from an explicit analytic inequality and exact-rational scalar bound; numerical quadrature is illustrative only. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a zero-temperature, infinite-chain, near-saturation scaling law; not a finite-distance complete phase diagram. A plausible older arbitrary-distance entanglement paper could not be fully examined and equivalence remains a priority risk.
title: Dilute-saturation XX-chain concurrence and a strict long-range onset discrepancy
